units.function: Embedded-Postgres service test that a manually initiated routine creates an issue/queued heartbeat path and emits a minimal product-telemetry event containing only trigger source and issue_created status.
units.dependencyDirection: Routine service creates persistent work and calls heartbeat wakeup; after the run reaches issue_created it invokes a shared telemetry helper with a global telemetry client and a two-field payload.
units.keyDataModels: Company/defaultResponsibleUserId; active Agent/project/routine; routine run source/status; issue executionRunId/lock; queued heartbeat run; product telemetry source/status.
units.lifecycle: Create active routine; invoke it manually; create issue and queued execution; return issue_created routine run; emit one minimal telemetry observation at initiation.
units.testAssessment: The source-level assertion demonstrates strong content minimization, but the single test was skipped locally because embedded PostgreSQL is unavailable. The telemetry helper itself is mocked and only the successful manual issue_created path exists. There is no assertion for completion, failure, cancellation, retries, duplicate delivery, sink failure, privacy policy or responsibility correlation.
units.designRationale: Measure routine adoption and initiation outcome without sending routine names, bodies, identifiers, Agent output or Secret data to product analytics.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs privacy-preserving usage analytics while maintaining a separate complete, queryable responsibility chain for every initiated and executed work item across managed and self-hosted deployments.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the minimal low-cardinality product event and absence of authored content. Treat it only as optional analytics. Emit authoritative typed domain/audit events for requested, planned, queued, executing, approval-paused, resumed, cancelled, timed-out, failed and completed transitions, linked by stable work/run/contract/Agent/human IDs and digests. Build analytics from redacted projections with deployment/consent policy; never use analytics delivery as responsibility evidence.
units.responsibilityConflict: The service call has no initiator actor and the seeded default responsible human is unused; source manual therefore does not identify a person. Status issue_created is not an execution result. Company OS must separately prove who initiated, who was accountable, which Agent executed, what authority/data was used, approvals, evidence and final outcome.

units.securityFindings: CRITICAL responsibility gap if mistaken for audit: no human initiator/accountable identity, work/run correlation or final result is present. HIGH lifecycle gap: only issue_created is covered, not execution/approval/terminal states. HIGH delivery gap: retries, duplicates, ordering and sink failure isolation are untested. HIGH deployment/privacy gap: consent, retention, residency and self-hosted disable/local sink behavior are absent. POSITIVE: asserted telemetry excludes IDs, names, descriptions, Secrets and Agent output.
